content: {"episode_id":"ep-05159","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Blue Summit denied CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, under reason code PR-204 as not covered under the member's current benefit plan, and this appeal details the clinical necessity as the letter directs. The clinical indication note documents a patient presenting with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2. Per that note, the cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset. We therefore request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial and payment of the outstanding balance of 430.52 for this medically necessary service."}
